name: meeting-intelligence-gold-v1
note: Small hand-labelled set. Meeting day is Wed 2026-11-25. Dates are exact calendar dates.

cases.description: Three owned tasks with spoken deadlines
cases.transcript:
[10:00] Priya: Quick planning for the mobile app. Rahul, please finish the login page by Friday.
[10:01] Rahul: Sure, I'll finish the login page by Friday.
[10:02] Priya: Amit, can you write the user data API within five days?
[10:03] Amit: Yes, within five days works.
[10:04] Priya: And I will prepare the release notes by the end of the month.

cases.description: Two tasks that each wait for the other
cases.transcript:
[11:00] Neha: Amit, you need to finish the payment module, but you can't finish it until Kunal sends the API keys.
[11:01] Kunal: I can't send the API keys until Amit finishes the payment module, because the keys are tied to the module.
[11:02] Neha: That is a deadlock. Kunal, please send the API keys by tomorrow, and Amit, finish the payment module within three days.

cases.description: No commitments at all: nothing should be extracted
cases.transcript:
[12:00] Maya: Did you see the match last night? Unbelievable ending.
[12:01] Jo: I missed it, the traffic was terrible and then it started raining.
[12:02] Maya: The weather has been odd all week. Anyway, the cafeteria has a new menu.
[12:03] Jo: Nice, I heard the pasta is good.

cases.description: A three-step chain expressed with sequencing words
cases.transcript:
[14:00] Sam: We have to ship the report. First Dana prepares the dataset, and only after that can Lee build the charts.
[14:01] Lee: Right, I will build the charts once the dataset is ready, then Maya writes the summary after the charts are done.
[14:02] Maya: Okay, I will write the summary after the charts. Dana, can you get the dataset ready by Thursday?
[14:03] Dana: Yes, I will have the dataset by Thursday.

cases.description: A task blocked by something outside the team, plus a relative deadline
cases.transcript:
[09:30] Ravi: Deploying to production is blocked until the security team approves the audit.
[09:31] Ravi: I will deploy the service as soon as the approval comes through.
[09:32] Tara: And I will update the runbook in two weeks.

cases.description: Decisions and facts must not become tasks; one real commitment exists
cases.transcript:
[16:00] Chair: We decided to move the database to Postgres.
[16:01] Chair: Everyone agreed the launch date stays December 15.
[16:02] Jo: I will send the migration plan tomorrow.
